artworks.title: St. Helen; St. Donatus; St. Ludovicus, Bishop; St. Bernard
artworks.description: The drawing consists of a 2x2 grid showing religious scenes. In the top left, a figure with a halo is kneeling outdoors with buildings in the background and rays from above. The scene is connected to St. Helena. In the top right, a figure is in a cave, with a person and a beast in the distance, possibly Saint Donatus. The lower left shows a figure in religious vestments blessing or addressing a kneeling figure, representing St. Ludovicus. In the bottom right, another figure is seated outside, engaged in reading or writing, representing St. Bernard. The drawing is detailed, capturing the spiritual scenes and surrounding architecture.

artworks.title: St. Philibert, Abbot; St. Privatus; St. Symphorian; St. Philip
artworks.description: This drawing depicts four religious scenes. In the top left, a figure with a halo extends a hand toward a body of water with ships; in the top right, two armored figures are attacking a figure; in the bottom left, a group of figures led by one with a halo is walking; and in the bottom right, a figure with a halo stands holding a cross in front of a town. Each scene is enclosed in an oval with titles and dates labeled at the bottom. The dates are in August.

artworks.title: St. Aurea; St. Bartholomew; St. Louis; St. Genesius
artworks.description: The image is divided into four panels depicting different historical and religious scenes. In the top left panel, labeled "S. AVREA VIRG.," three figures in robes stand by a body of water. One figure appears to be baptizing another, while a third figure holds a staff. Buildings line the shoreline in the background. The top right panel, labeled "S. BARTHOLOMEVS APLUS," shows a figure tied to an X-shaped cross with two other figures in loincloths nearby. Ruins and open skies are in the background. In the bottom left panel, titled "S. LVDOVICVS REX FRANCIAE," a figure in regal attire stands in front of an architectural backdrop, holding a scepter. The bottom right panel, "S. GENNEYS MART.," features three figures; a kneeling person is tended to by a robed figure and angels, with architectural structures and onlookers in the background. The panels have an ornate, historical illustrative style.

artworks.title: St. Patricia; Sts. Secundus and Alexander; St. Cesarius; St. Augustine
artworks.description: The image is divided into four oval panels, each featuring different people. In the panel marked "25 Aug," a figure faces left wearing a wide-brimmed hat and long robe, carrying a staff, with other similarly dressed figures in the background and the dome of a building visible. The panel labeled "26 Aug" shows a group of people in various poses; one figure in profile, wearing a halo, is escorted by others towards a structure, with another person gesturing towards the group. The "27 Aug" section presents a figure in profile facing left, also in a wide-brimmed hat and robe, reaching out towards a group of figures standing in front of a large architectural element like a column. The "28 Aug" panel features a bearded man with a halo standing and holding a book, wearing a robe, with another person kneeling at his feet and ancient-looking buildings in the background. Each scene contains specific elements such as hats and halos, suggesting figures of significance, set against background elements like buildings and columns.

artworks.title: St. Mederic, Abbot; Beheading of John the Baptist; St. Fiacre; Festival of the Belt of the Virgin
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four separate ovals depicting different scenes. In the top left oval, figures are gathered around a seated figure in saintly robes in an ancient village. The top right oval shows a figure in distress or defeat, with additional figures in a lavish interior setting. The bottom left oval portrays a figure standing majestically with others kneeling before them. The bottom right oval depicts a robed figure engaged in an activity in a natural landscape, with a walled town in the background. The composition, style, and line work suggest a focus on religious narratives or historical representations.

artworks.title: St. Giles; St. Lupus; St. Anne; St. Nonnosus
artworks.description: This drawing features four distinct oval illustrations depicting various scenes with religious figures. The top-left scene shows a figure sitting under trees with a deer nearby. The top-right illustration depicts a figure standing at an altar with others behind them. The bottom-left image shows a figure standing with an outstretched arm pointing towards an architectural structure, accompanied by several others. The bottom-right scene shows a figure kneeling and gesturing towards a cloud formation. The drawings are labeled with different names and titles, indicating a religious or saintly context.

artworks.title: St. Mansuetus; Sts. Serapia and Erasma; Moses; St. Bertin, Abbot
artworks.description: The image shows four oval illustrations of biblical or saintly figures with labels of their names and feast days in September. The top left illustration features Saint Mansuetus, a bishop in profile holding a crozier. The top right shows Saint Seraphia and Saint Erasma with an angel. The bottom left depicts Moses holding the tablets of the Ten Commandments. The bottom right shows Saint Bertin gesturing towards a boat on a shore. Each figure is in minimalistic settings.

artworks.title: St. Eleutherius, Abbot; St. Regina; St. John; The Nativity of the Virgin
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four oval scenes. The first scene shows a religious figure in long robes outside a small church. The second scene depicts a figure standing in a tub of water with others around and a dove flying above. The third scene shows a figure addressing a crowd on a city street. The fourth scene shows a woman in bed with figures attending to an infant. Each scene is labeled with religious or saintly names, marked "SEPT." and numerals. The drawing's style suggests intricate line work similar to engravings.

artworks.title: Sts. Gorgonius & Dorothy; St. Nicholas of Tolentino; St. Polianus & Nemesian; St. Pulcheria
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four circular vignette illustrations arranged in a grid, each depicting different scenes. The top left scene shows a stylized whipping, the top right shows a praying figure alongside architectural details, the bottom left depicts figures engaged in a confrontation, while the bottom right features a robed figure holding staffs. Each vignette is distinctly labeled with dates in September and Latin annotations. The lines are minimal and fine.

artworks.title: St. Paphnutius; Sts. Macedonius and Theodulus; St. Amatus; St. Cornelias
artworks.description: Four circular illustrations featuring biblical or religious themes are described. Each illustration is contained within its own circular frame and labeled with saints or religious figures alongside specific days in September. The top left illustration shows a figure with a mitre by a hut grasping a long wooden plank. The top right illustration depicts a figure lying on a bed-like structure surrounded by others, one holding a staff, with ancient architecture in the background. The bottom left illustration shows a figure standing among rock formations holding an object. The bottom right scene portrays a moment of execution or martyrdom, with one figure raising a sword over another amidst urban ruins. The scenes are outlined in a traditional etching style.

artworks.title: Exaltation of the Holy Cross; St. Aper; St. Euphemia; St. Lambert
artworks.description: This drawing features four oval-shaped vignettes, each representing a date in September with different religious scenes. The top left vignette depicts figures in an ancient setting, with one carrying a large cross. The top right shows a figure in robes addressing three seated figures, framed by religious architecture. The bottom left shows an angel appearing to a kneeling person in a dramatic landscape. The bottom right depicts a religious figure pointing upwards, surrounded by other figures. The drawing is detailed with precise line work and shading, creating depth in each scene.

artworks.title: St. Ferreolus; St. Januarius; St. Eustachius & his Children; Sts. Fausta & Evelasius
artworks.description: The image contains four separate illustrations within oval frames. The top left frame shows a figure holding chains. They are bald with aged facial features and a halo, dressed in robes, with a background of buildings. The top right frame shows a figure holding a palm branch and a book, with a halo, wearing draped robes, and an architectural background. The bottom left frame features a large ox facing the viewer with people in the background. The bottom right frame shows two figures engaged in labor tasks with buildings in the background. Each frame is inscribed with annotations and dates marking them as belonging to September.

artworks.title: St. Canida; St. Matthew; St. Ipigenia; St. Maurice and Companions
artworks.description:
The image is divided into four separate illustrations, each occupying a quadrant of the frame. In the top left quadrant, two figures are standing over a seated figure. The standing figures are holding bound groups of sticks. This segment is labeled "S. Candida Virg. Et M." The top right quadrant depicts a figure, who appears to be a bearded man with a halo, adorned in a robe, holding a book or tablet. This figure is accompanied by a smaller winged figure, likely an angel. This segment reads "S. Matheus. Aplvs."

The bottom left quadrant features two figures, one adult and one child, with the adult figure holding a dish towards the child. The adult figure is also haloed and dressed in flowing garments, while the child, who is kneeling, appears to be receiving something. The setting is against the backdrop of a simple church-like structure. This is labeled "S. Iphigenia Virg." Finally, the bottom right quadrant shows a crowd scene with multiple figures, centered around one main figure in armor with a halo, seemingly leading the group. All are carrying long-standard spears. The background here is sparse, with the focus on the figures, and it reads "S. Mavritivs Cum Sociis."

artworks.title: St. Thecla; St. Linus; Sts. Andochius and Thyrsus; St. Cleophas
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four religious scenes, each contained within an oval frame indicating different dates in September. The top left scene shows a figure kneeling in prayer with another figure holding a staff behind her near a cityscape. The top right scene shows two figures interacting. The bottom left scene depicts two figures hanging by their hands with objects scattered below. The bottom right image shows a group of three figures engaged in conversation with elements of architecture in the background. The artwork features fine line work and typical religious iconography.

artworks.title: St. Calistratus; Sts. Cyprian and Justina; Sts. Comus and Damian; St. Elzear, Count
artworks.description: The image contains four illustrations arranged in two rows, each featuring figures within oval frames. In the top left illustration, a person kneels in profile riding a sea creature. The background shows a distant cityscape. The top right illustration features a male and female figure with halos, one holding a staff and the other a crucifix with a creature nearby. The bottom left shows figures identified as St. Cosma and St. Damian holding objects, with architectural structures in the background. The bottom right depicts a haloed figure holding a plant and a rosary, with small buildings and a kneeling figure in the background. Each illustration is labeled with the name of the saint(s) and the date "Sept" along with a day of the month.

artworks.title: St. Wenceslas; St. Michael, Archangel; The Guardian Angel; St. Jerome
artworks.description: The image depicts four oval-shaped illustrations, each labeled and dated for late September. The first scene shows a crowned figure on horseback gesturing towards a kneeling figure with an angelic form in the sky and a pastoral landscape. The second scene features a winged figure standing triumphantly over a subjugated creature. The third illustration shows an angel guiding a pilgrim-like figure with a staff against a cloudy backdrop. The final image portrays a bearded figure kneeling near a crucifix amidst rocky terrain under a tumultuous sky. Each illustration contains intricate linework and conveys narrative and symbolism typical of religious or allegorical art.

artworks.title: St. Remigius; St. Leodegarius; St. Gerard, Abbot; St. Francis of Assisi
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring four circular panels depicting different religious scenes. The top-left panel shows a standing figure with an aura above a seated figure and two others nearby. The top-right panel shows a central figure in clerical garments with two others. The lower-left panel shows monks and a cleric in a church-like setting. The lower-right panel shows a reclining figure in a natural setting with beams of light from the sky. The style is reminiscent of classic religious iconography with detailed line work.

artworks.title: St. Theresa; St. Placidus and Flavia; St. Bruno; St. Faith
artworks.description: This drawing features four scenes with religious iconography. Each scene is framed in an oval with Latin text and numbers likely indicating dates. The first scene shows a figure titled "Sancta Teresia." The second scene is titled "SS. Placidxs et Flavia" and shows two figures in an action scene with a ship. The third scene, titled "Sbruno. Cartvsianvs," features an individual holding palm fronds with mystical creatures in the background. The final scene, "S. Fides V. et Mar," shows two figures in a dynamic stance. The drawings are detailed with intricate lines depicting moral or spiritual narratives.

artworks.title: St. Mary of Victory; St. Simeon, Prophet; St. Pelagia; Sts. Reparata and Benedicta
artworks.description:
This is a drawing of four separate religious scenes. The drawing is divided into four sections, each depicting different scenes inspired by religious or saintly figures. Each vignette is oval-shaped and labeled with the name of a saint and a date in October.

1. The top-left section features a scene of naval battle or a maritime setting related to Saint Maria de Victora.

2. The top-right depicts two figures in a religious setting, potentially Saint Simeon receiving a visitor amid a hilly landscape with buildings.

3. In the bottom-left, a kneeling figure in a penitent position amidst a rocky terrain likely represents St. Pelagia engaged in prayer with witnesses observing from a distance.

4. The bottom-right shows Saint Reparata facing a scene with multiple figures, some holding palms, and an act of martyrdom or sacrifice. 

The style is detailed and narrative, capturing moments from hagiographies.

artworks.title: St. Dionysius, Rusticus & Eleutherius; St. Abraham; St. Gereon & Companions; Sts. Probus &  Andronichus
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four religious scenes depicted in chronological order corresponding to dates in October. The top left shows one individual being led away by another, with a larger figure holding a cloak over the first. Ruins or structures are visible in the background. The top right displays a figure holding a knife above an altar, with an angelic figure descending from the sky. The bottom left depicts a group engaged in a collective action on a battlefield. The bottom right shows two figures bound to wooden stakes, with others around them in various postures. Each illustration is labeled with dates in October and additional text.

artworks.title: St. Maximilian; St. Carpus; St. Daniel and Angelus; St. Fortunatus
artworks.description: The image consists of four separate drawings arranged in two rows and two columns. The top left image shows Saint Maximilian standing with a bishop's crosier, wearing a mitre and robe. Ruins are visible in the background. The top right image shows Saint Carpus kneeling and facing a building under a cloudy sky. The bottom left depicts Saints Daniel and Angelus, one with a halo and the other raising a sword behind him, with a structure in the background. The bottom right shows Saint Fortunatus standing with arms raised, wearing bishop attire and holding a cross, with a twisted tree and two other figures in the background under a clouded sky. Each scene is enclosed within an oval frame on a plain background.

artworks.title: St. Calixtus; St. Hedwiges; Sts. Martinian and Saturian; St. Florentinus
artworks.description:
This image consists of four distinct illustrations, each contained within a circular frame and labeled with specific dates in October and text indicating names or titles. 

1. The top-left illustration shows a figure positioned head down, descending into a large well or vat. The person has short, wavy hair and wears a tunic. Surrounding them are a brick wall and distant figures engaged in poses. 

2. The top-right illustration depicts a kneeling figure tending to a seated person, possibly washing their feet. Both figures wear robes and are set against an outdoor backdrop with other people walking. 

3. The bottom-left illustration shows two figures with short hair and beards, each wearing cloaks and circular halos. They stand outdoors with a distant building structure. 

4. The bottom-right illustration features a bearded figure kneeling or standing in prayer at an altar or pulpit, wearing a mitre and a cloak. The background shows a building, likely a church, and open space outdoors.

artworks.title: St. Luke; St. Lucian; St. Irene; St. Hilarion
artworks.description: The image contains four oval illustrations depicting different religious figures. In the top left panel, a person is sitting and painting on an easel with a bull nearby. The figure wears a long robe and a halo around their head. In the top right panel, an individual is standing on a hilltop ready to strike another figure lying in front of them. The background shows rolling hills and a small structure. The bottom left panel features two figures, one kneeling and one standing. In the bottom right illustration, a person is kneeling on a cliffside with overgrown hair, wearing a loincloth and praying or meditating with hands pressed onto a rock, with a cross beside them. The background displays a barren landscape with another human figure in the distance.

artworks.title: St. Ursula and Companions; St. Mary Salome; St. Severinus; St. Maglorius
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four religious scenes. The first scene shows a group of figures within an oval frame labeled "S. URSULA CVM SOCIAB" and dated "21 Octob." The second scene features a solitary figure holding a jar near crucifixes, labeled "S. MARIA SALOME" and dated "22 Octob." The third scene presents a seated figure looking up towards the sky, labeled "S. SEVERINVS EPVS" and dated "23 Octob." The fourth scene depicts a standing figure holding a bishop's mitre and crosier, as an angel watches from above, labeled "S. MAGLORIVS EPVS" and dated "24 Octob." The drawing is done in delicate linework and laid out in a grid format on a plain background.
